english: a leopard cannot change its spots
also: a fox changes its fur, not its nature
a tiger never changes his stripes
the leopard doesn’t change its spots

terms.comment: Literally “the fox changes its fur, not its ways”. Suetonius reports it as a saying.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency.
Quotations marked “Lewis & Short” are given as Lewis & Short cites them, in the house spelling; they have not been checked against a modern edition.
